name: Card Stack
line: A deck of six paper cards on a dark table, set in Lexend: each section is a card that slides up and settles over the last while the cards behind shrink and dim a little, from a bone hero card with the search, through a charcoal card with the lesson's bars drawn to scale, sand and taupe cards for the two explorers and an oxblood card for Code Against Cancer, to the games.
notes: The stacking is CSS position: sticky plus a few lines of JavaScript that measure each card, so a card taller than the screen (phones) settles by its bottom edge and nothing is ever hidden; the shrink and dim of the cards behind are scroll-linked. Without JavaScript or with reduced motion the cards form a plain column. The network drawings are used as CSS masks printed in the card's ink. Lexend covers Latin and Vietnamese only; Chinese and Cyrillic fall back to system fonts.
